architecture_contract.declared_model: scikit-learn logistic regression trained on K562 CRISPR enhancer-gene labels
architecture_contract.warning: Coefficients, intercept, classes, solver metadata, and exact fitted training receipt remain unverified because model.pkl was not acquired or deserialized.

checkpoint.historical_identity: The same Git blob is present at v1.0.0 commit 1bfa1a4190d4462fd8aaa3970c09a0f398ed9c96 dated 2024-06-04.

input_contract.accessibility: GSE296875 donor-by-cell-state ATAC pseudobulk; no held-donor fragments, peaks, normalization, or gene filtering in development evaluation
input_contract.contact: exact reference MegaMap Hi-C artifact required because the official repository has no pretrained power-law rE2G model
input_contract.h3k27ac: structurally_missing; therefore use atac_megamap, never an H3K27ac model with zero imputation
input_contract.missingness: A structural, permission, join, or QC missing value rejects the row or lane before the model adapter. The upstream blanket fillna(0) behavior is not admitted.
input_contract.reference: GRCh38 coordinates plus project GENCODE v49 gene/TSS authority
input_contract.reference_mismatch: The upstream application config uses a 2017 RefSeq-curated TSS and promoter-class authority. A frozen gene crosswalk is required, and an unmatched covariate is missing rather than zero.
input_contract.variant_mapping: Map variants to frozen candidate elements, then carry the continuous rE2G link score to each candidate target gene. rE2G does not consume REF or ALT sequence.

representation_and_task_contract.sealed_behavior: Apply the converted fixed logistic coefficients to a development-built cell-state ATAC plus MegaMap feature atlas, hash the atlas before sealed features are opened, and overlap evaluator-provided variants without sealed ATAC.
representation_and_task_contract.threshold_policy: Use continuous ENCODE-rE2G.Score for benchmark metrics. The upstream 0.179 threshold is a K562 CRISPR recall operating point and is diagnostic only in liver.
representation_and_task_contract.variant_endpoint_status: eligible as an unsigned link/retrieval baseline or component, not as a standalone signed-effect model

safe_loading_contract.require_restricted_one_time_extraction: Extract only LogisticRegression coefficients, intercept, classes, n_features_in, feature_names_in when present, and required scalar metadata; reject every unexpected class or callable.
safe_loading_contract.require_safe_project_artifact: Re-serialize reviewed numeric arrays and metadata to non-executable project-owned artifacts, freeze SHA-256, and use a direct formula adapter thereafter.

source_evidence: The exact official repository commit, v1.0.0 tag, model-tree metadata, feature table, threshold filename, MIT license, current ABC submodule revision, environment, application code, and training code were queried on 2026-08-22. No pickle, package, reference/contact file, or data was downloaded, no object was deserialized, and no model code was executed.
